P21-18.name: The SnakeMasterDeity Asklepiooze X
P21-18.effect:
While you have a Mirage set, this set card is unaffected by opposing effects.

[Burst: After your Spirit is Destroyed by the Opponent]
Send three cores from an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Trash, and when depletes, draw three cards. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3]
When your "Galaxian" family Spirits are destroyed by comparing BP, they can remain on the Field, refreshed.

P21-14.name: Battle Spirits Mirage (Card)
P21-14.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 4 ([White Core][White Core])]
[During Set] (Your Attack Step)
While your one-symbol “Proximate”/“Astroblazer” family Spirit is attacking as the first attack of the turn, that Spirit can't be blocked.

[Flash]
Return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.

P21-12.name: Kamen Rider 50th Anniversary
P21-12.effect:
When using this card, the symbols of every "50th"-named Spirit you control are also treated as Red.

[Mirage: Cost 2]
[During Set] (Your Attack Step)
For each Spirit you control, your attacking “50th”-named Spirit gains +3000 BP, and while it has 30000 BP or more, it gains an extra Red symbol.

[Flash]
Destroy 50 opposing 7000 BP or less Spirits.

P21-13.name: Synchroid Bronto
P21-13.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 4 ([White Core][White Core])]
[During Set] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Proximate"/“Astroblazer” & “Machine Beast” family Spirit would leave the Field due to opposing effects, if you have fewer cards in Hand than the opponent, you can draw until you have the same number of cards in the opposing Hand.

[LV2] (Either Main Step)
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to opposing effects, it can remain on the Field, in the same condition.

P21-15.name: The SunStarDragon Heliopause-Dragon
P21-15.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 5 ([Red Core][Red Core][Green Core][Green Core])]
[During Set] (Your Attack Step)
When your Spirit is blocked, destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate, and the effects of the destroyed Spirit/Ultimate can't activate.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Ultra Clash] (When Attacks)
Opposing Spirits/Ultimates must block if possible. This effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.

P21-16.name: What Are You, Fool?
P21-16.effect:
[Flash]
Destroy an opposing Nexus, and when destroys, draw a card. When a Rebirth Nexus is destroyed, this effect draws +1 card.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14501.name: Xain-Traill
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14501.effect:
[LV1][LV2] Red/Blue (Opposing Turn)
When the opponent uses a Red/Blue Magic effect, by exhausting this Spirit, negate that effect.

[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Main Step)
When the opposing Hand increases, for each card added, the opponent discards a card from their Hand.

P21-20.name: Zodiac Draco
P21-20.effect:
This card's reduction symbol is also treated as Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue.

[LV1][LV2] [Astmu: 1] (When Summoned)
You can put a card from your decktop to the Removed Zone. You can add a "Proximate"/"Astroblazer" & “Galaxian” family card being put to the Removed Zone by this effect to your Hand. When you've done so, return an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit to the deckbottom.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Draw a card.
